arxiv-1312-6350.title: Sparse Portfolio Selection via
arxiv-1312-6350.creator: Quasi-Norm Regularization
arxiv-1312-6350.description: Abstract Abstract In this paper, we propose \ell_{p} -norm regularized models to seek near-optimal sparse portfolios. These sparse solutions reduce the complexity of portfolio implementation and management. Theoretical results are established to guarantee the sparsity of the second-order KKT points of the \ell_{p} -norm regularized models.

arxiv-1710-09865.title: Blowing bubbles on the torus Thanks: The authors hereby waive all copyright and related or neighboring rights to this work, and dedicate it to the public domain. This applies worldwide.
arxiv-1710-09865.creator: Peter Doyle, Jean Steiner
arxiv-1710-09865.description: Abstract We consider the regularized trace of the inverse of the Laplacian on a skinny torus. With its flat metric, a skinny torus has large trace, but we show that there are conformally equivalent metrics making the trace close to that of a sphere of the same area.

arxiv-2112-00153.title: Coulomb corrections to pi-pi scattering
arxiv-2112-00153.creator: Tuan Nguyen
arxiv-2112-00153.description: Abstract The relationship between finite volume multi-hadron energy levels and matrix elements and two particle scattering phase shifts and decays is well known, but the inclusion of long range interactions such as QED is non-trivial. Inclusion of QED is an important systematic error correction to K → π ​ π K\to\pi\pi decays.

arxiv-2210-02987.title: TrustVault: A privacy-first data wallet for the European Blockchain Services Infrastructure
arxiv-2210-02987.creator: Sharif Jacobino and Johan Pouwelse
arxiv-2210-02987.description: Abstract Abstract— The European Union is on course to introduce a European Digital Identity that will be available to all EU citizens and businesses. This will have a huge impact on how citizens and businesses interact online. Big Tech companies currently dictate how digital identities are used. As a result, they have amassed vast amounts of private user data.

arxiv-2307-04971.creator: Yi C. Huang
arxiv-2307-04971.description: Abstract . For absolutely convergent series we state explicitly a one-sided summation estimate that can be viewed as the discrete analogue of the change of variable formula on the half line. This estimate is implicit in Pascal Lefèvre’s recent elegant proof of the classical discrete Hardy inequality.

arxiv-2311-16951.title: Three-dimensional internal flow evolution of an evaporating droplet and its role in particle deposition pattern
arxiv-2311-16951.creator: Jiaqi Li, Jiarong Hong
arxiv-2311-16951.description: Abstract The internal flow within an evaporating sessile droplet is one of the driving mechanisms that lead to the variety of particle deposition patterns seen in applications such as inkjet printing, surface patterning, and blood stain analysis. Despite decades of research, the causal link between droplet internal flow and particle deposition patterns has not been fully established.

arxiv-2408-00799.creator: Xin Jiang, Kaiqiang Wang, Yinlong Wang, Fengchang Lv, Taiyang Peng, Shuai Yang, Xianteng Wu, Pengye Zhang, Shuo Yuan, Yifan Zeng
arxiv-2408-00799.description: Abstract . In recommendation systems, the relevance and novelty of the final results are selected through a cascade system of Matching -> Ranking -> Strategy. The matching model serves as the starting point of the pipeline and determines the upper bound of the subsequent stages.

arxiv-2412-05241.title: Simultaneous identification of the parameters in the plasticity function for power hardening materials : A Bayesian approach
arxiv-2412-05241.creator: Salih Tatar, Mohamed BenSalah
arxiv-2412-05241.description: Abstract In this paper, we study simultaneous determination of the strain hardening exponent, the shear modulus and the yield stress in an inverse problem. First, we analyze the direct and the inverse problems. Then we formulate the inverse problem in the Bayesian framework.

arxiv-2501-16183.title: Melting through Barrier-Crossing: The Role of Equilibrium Thermally Activated Particles
arxiv-2501-16183.creator: Rongchao Ma
arxiv-2501-16183.description: Abstract Melting is often understood in purely equilibrium terms, where crystalline order disappears once the free energy of the solid equals that of the liquid. Yet at the microscopic level, the initiating events for melting can often be traced to the formation of defects or local “jumps” over interatomic barriers.

arxiv-2508-09032.title: Spatial Traces: Enhancing VLA Models with Spatial-Temporal Understanding
arxiv-2508-09032.creator: Maxim A. Patratskiy, Alexey K. Kovalev, Aleksandr I. Panov
arxiv-2508-09032.description: Abstract Vision-Language-Action models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in predicting agent movements within virtual environments and real-world scenarios based on visual observations and textual instructions. Although recent research has focused on enhancing spatial and temporal understanding independently, this paper presents a novel approach that integrates both aspects through visual prompting.

arxiv-2509-16367.title: Fast momentum-selective transport of Bose-Einstein condensates via controlled non-adiabatic dynamics in optical lattices
arxiv-2509-16367.creator: Raja Chamakhi, Dana Codruta Marinica, Naceur Gaaloul, Eric Charron, Mourad Telmini
arxiv-2509-16367.description: Abstract We present a detailed numerical study of a protocol for momentum-selective transport of a Bose–Einstein condensate (BEC) in a one-dimensional optical lattice, achieving narrow momentum distributions through controlled non-adiabatic dynamics. The protocol consists of non-adiabatic loading into the lattice, coherent acceleration using a symmetric trapezoidal acceleration profile, and non-adiabatic release into free space.

arxiv-2601-16737.title: Automated Road Crack Localization to Guide Highway Maintenance Journal: Journal
arxiv-2601-16737.creator: Steffen Knoblauch, Ram Kumar Muthusamy, Pedram Ghamisi, Alexander Zipf
arxiv-2601-16737.description: Abstract Highway networks are crucial for economic prosperity. Climate change-induced temperature fluctuations are exacerbating stress on road pavements, resulting in elevated maintenance costs. This underscores the need for targeted and efficient maintenance strategies. This study investigates the potential of open-source data to guide highway infrastructure maintenance.

pmc-11496528.title: Evolution of the surface phase transitions in IrTe2
pmc-11496528.creator: Govinda Kharal, Bryan L Chavez, Silu Huang, Rongying Jin, Yanwen Wu
pmc-11496528.description: The phase transitions in IrTe2 have been extensively studied but the symmetry at each phase is yet to be settled. Employing second harmonic generation (SHG) measurements over a temperature range of 4 –300 K, we probe the evolution of the symmetry of IrTe2.

pmc-11508713.description: Simple SummaryThe Apis mellifera sinisxinyuan is a kind of western honeybee with strong cold hardiness. However, the cold tolerance mechanism of A. m. sinisxinyuan is still not clear. Here, we analyzed the supercooling point and transcriptome data of A. m.

pmc-12614101.title: A fast sample shuttle to couple high and low magnetic fields and applications in high-resolution relaxometry
pmc-12614101.creator: Jorge A. Villanueva-Garibay, Andreas Tilch, Ana Paula Aguilar Alva, Guillaume Bouvignies, Frank Engelke, Fabien Ferrage, Agnes Glémot, Ulric B. le Paige, Giulia Licciardi, Claudio Luchinat, Giacomo Parigi, Philippe Pelupessy, Enrico Ravera, Alessandro Ruda, Lucas Siemons, Olof Stenström, Jean-Max Ty
pmc-12614101.description: Combining high-resolution high-field nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) with an evolution of spin systems at a low magnetic field offers many opportunities for the investigation of molecular motions and hyperpolarization and the exploration of field-dependent spin dynamics. Fast and reproducible transfer between high and low fields is required to minimize polarization losses due to longitudinal relaxation.

pmc-12866313.title: Development and validation of a prognostic nomogram based on inflammation and Nutrition-Related Indexes for predicting postoperative survival in patients with pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors
pmc-12866313.creator: Nanwei Ye, Ming Jin, Yuancong Jiang, Jie Qiu, Zhenzhen Gao, Sheng Yan, Bo Zhou
pmc-12866313.description: BackgroundPancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNETs) are rare malignant tumors. While surgical resection is the primary therapeutic approach, postoperative survival outcomes remain suboptimal. This study aims to investigate the prognostic value of inflammation and nutrition-related indicators, such as Prognostic nutritional index (PNI), Neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), Platelet-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), Systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), and Lymphocyte-monocyte ratio (LMR), in patients with pNETs undergoing surgery.

pmc-13115663.title: MV-HAGCN: Prediction of miRNA-Disease Association Based on Multi-View Hybrid Attention Graph Convolutional Network
pmc-13115663.creator: Konglin Xing, Yujing Zhang, Wen Zhu
pmc-13115663.description: Accurate identification of disease-associated microRNAs (miRNAs) is crucial for elucidating pathogenic mechanisms and advancing therapeutic discovery. Although computational methods, particularly those based on biological networks, have become essential tools for predicting miRNA-disease associations, existing approaches often struggle to comprehensively learn from heterogeneous data and optimize feature representations.

pmc-13165127.title: Bibliometric Analysis and Thematic Evolution of Advanced Oxidation Processes for Persistent Organic Pollutant Degradation (2000–2026)
pmc-13165127.creator: Segundo Jonathan Rojas-Flores, Rafael Liza, Félix Díaz, Daniel Delfin-Narciso, Moisés Gallozzo Cardenas, Renny Nazario-Naveda
pmc-13165127.description: Pollution by persistent organic pollutants (POPs) constitutes an environmental and public health crisis of planetary scale due to their toxicity, persistence, and capacity for bioaccumulation in ecosystems. Given the limitations of conventional methods, which are often costly or generate hazardous byproducts, advanced oxidation processes (AOPs) have emerged as critical alternatives for the terminal destruction of these compounds.

pmc-13593067.title: Goltz Syndrome With Large Esophageal Squamous Papillomas—A Unique Cause of Dysphagia Amenable to Endoscopic Treatment
pmc-13593067.creator: Pius Ehiremen Ojemolon, Hayalneh Gessessew, Bereket Abraha Molla, Juwairiya Arshi, Raymond Kim, Sonali Sakaria
pmc-13593067.description: Focal dermal hypoplasia, also referred to as Goltz syndrome, is a rare X-linked dominant multisystem disorder primarily affecting women, with an estimated prevalence of roughly 1 per 1 million individuals. The condition arises from pathogenic variants in the PORCN gene, resulting in disrupted Wnt signaling and subsequent developmental abnormalities involving the skin, skeletal system, and various other tissues.

pmc-13638102.title: Synthesis and Activity‐Based Protein Profiling Identifies Aldo‐Keto Reductase 1C3 as Target Protein of Myxoglucamides
pmc-13638102.creator: Thomas Siemon, Vivek K. Mishra, Mingming Zhao, Konrad Büssow, Alexander Popoff, Chengzhang Fu, Rolf Müller, Lothar Jänsch, Wulf Blankenfeldt, Mark Brönstrup
pmc-13638102.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Myxoglucamides, natural products recently isolated from Cystobacterineae sp., are featured by an unprecedented vinyl‐substituted α‐keto‐γ‐amino acid that is linked to a glycosylated 14‐methyl‐pentadecanoic acid. Thus, they unite elements from three biomolecular classes in a compact glycolipopeptide. To elucidate the biological relevance of this arrangement, we searched for molecular targets by activity‐based protein profiling (ABPP)—although a phenotypic bioactivity has not been reported. An access to the compound class was established through the first total synthesis of myxoglucamide A in 11 steps.
